one_liner: An open-source and cloud eCommerce platform providing rich APIs for online stores.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2.0, Bearer token generation via admin login, and token-based integration keys.
access_notes: Magento Open Source is free to download and run locally; Adobe Commerce offers developer environments.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs covering products, categories, orders, customers, inventory, and carts.
blocker_notes: Fully open-source and self-hostable with broad public APIs.

auth.quote:
Three types of authentication:

- Administrators and customers are authenticated with login credentials.
- Mobile applications authenticate using tokens.
- Third-party applications authenticate with OAuth 1.0a.

access.quote:
Build your commerce vision
Adobe provides developers with software, tools, and services to customize and extend Adobe Commerce to support multichannel, global commerce for B2B and B2C

api.quote: Support for GraphQL, REST(Representational State Transfer) and SOAP(Simple Object Access Protocol).

mcp.quote: Freento MCP Server connects your Magento 2 store to AI assistants via the https://modelcontextprotocol.io/ - an open standard for AI-to-application integration.

verdict.quote: The Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source web API framework provides integrators and developers the means to use web services that communicate with the application.
